s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging, asymptomatic, reddish-brown plaque with ecchymosis in the axilla
salient_findings: Asymptomatic, reddish-brown annular plaque with peripheral ecchymosis
Vascular channel endothelial cells positive for CD31, CD34, and D2-40
key_facts: 5-year history of gradually enlarging plaque
No previous history of trauma
No systemic symptoms
No improvement with topical antifungal cream
Nonindurated and well-defined plaque
No local lymphadenopathy
Vascular channel endothelial cells positive for CD31, CD34, and D2-40
Negative for human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8) and Wilms tumor 1 (WT1)
Ki-67 index showed low proliferation in endothelial cells
HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C serologic tests were negative

raw.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging, asymptomatic, reddish-brown plaque with ecchymosis in the axilla
salient_findings: Asymptomatic, reddish-brown annular plaque with peripheral ecchymosis
Vascular channel endothelial cells positive for CD31, CD34, and D2-40
key_facts: 5-year history of gradually enlarging plaque
No previous history of trauma
No systemic symptoms
No improvement with topical antifungal cream
Nonindurated and well-defined plaque
No local lymphadenopathy
Vascular channel endothelial cells positive for CD31, CD34, and D2-40
Negative for human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8) and Wilms tumor 1 (WT1)
Ki-67 index showed low proliferation in endothelial cells
HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C serologic tests were negative

raw.rationale: The clinical presentation of a gradually enlarging, reddish hematomalike plaque with a brownish peripheral border, combined with the histologic findings of poorly defined, superficial, and deep dermal vascular proliferation and the presence of promontory signs, is consistent with targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma. The immunohistochemical profile, including positivity for CD31, CD34, and D2-40, and the absence of HHV-8 and WT1, also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: Typically presents with more aggressive features and systemic symptoms, which are not present in this case

rejected.label: Hobnail hemangioma
rejected.why: Characterized by a distinctive hobnail appearance of endothelial cells, which is not mentioned in the histologic findings

rejected.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
rejected.why: Usually associated with POEMS syndrome, which is not indicated in the vignette, and has a distinct glomeruloid appearance not described here

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: Typically associated with HHV-8 positivity, which is negative in this case, and often presents with more widespread lesions and systemic symptoms
